description.value:
You know how to carry yourself gracefully as a noble ambassador. You gain the following benefits.

Comprehension. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplComprehend]{Comprehend Languages}, but only as a Ritual. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

Polyglot. You learn one language from the Player's Handbook language tables (or chapter 2 of Heroes of Faerûn). When you finish a Long Rest, you can replace a language learned this way with another language you have heard, seen signed, or read in the past 24 hours.

Well Spoken. You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Insight, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.
